```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(nycflights13)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
# Count unique named storms per year and plot the trend over time
storms |>
  distinct(year, name) |>
  count(year) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Named Tropical Storms per Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
flights_jfk <- flights |>
  filter(origin == "JFK") |>
  select(dep_delay, arr_delay, carrier)
```

```{r}
flights_jfk |>
  ggplot(aes(x = dep_delay, y = arr_delay, color = carrier)) +
  geom_point()
```
